_meta.description: The 39 engineering parameters of the classic Altshuller contradiction matrix. Names follow the usual English numbering; definitions and aliases are this project's own wording.

parameters.name: Weight of moving object
parameters.definition: The mass of an object that moves or is moved, and the force gravity puts on it.

parameters.name: Weight of stationary object
parameters.definition: The mass of an object that stays in place, and the load it puts on its support.

parameters.name: Length of moving object
parameters.definition: Any linear size of a moving object: length, width, height or depth.

parameters.name: Length of stationary object
parameters.definition: Any linear size of an object that does not move.

parameters.name: Area of moving object
parameters.definition: The surface size of a moving object, inside or outside.
aliases: contact area of a moving part

parameters.name: Area of stationary object
parameters.definition: The surface size of an object that does not move.

parameters.name: Volume of moving object
parameters.definition: The space a moving object takes up or encloses.

parameters.name: Volume of stationary object
parameters.definition: The space a stationary object takes up or encloses.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.definition: How fast an object moves or a process runs: distance or progress per unit of time.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.definition: Any push or pull that changes an object's motion or shape.

parameters.name: Stress or pressure
parameters.definition: Force per unit of area acting on or inside an object.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.definition: The outer form and outline of an object.

parameters.name: Stability of the object's composition
parameters.definition: How well an object keeps its integrity and the relation of its parts over time: resistance to decay, wear and breaking apart.

parameters.name: Strength
parameters.definition: How much force an object can take before it breaks.

parameters.name: Duration of action of moving object
parameters.definition: How long a moving object can do its job: service life or time between failures.
aliases: battery life of a mobile device

parameters.name: Duration of action by stationary object
parameters.definition: How long a stationary object can do its job.

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.definition: How hot or cold an object or system is, including heat it takes in or gives off.

parameters.name: Illumination intensity
parameters.definition: Light falling on or coming from an object, and its brightness, color and quality.

parameters.name: Use of energy by moving object
parameters.definition: The energy a moving object needs to do its job.
aliases: energy consumption of a moving part

parameters.name: Use of energy by stationary object
parameters.definition: The energy a stationary object needs to do its job.

parameters.name: Power
parameters.definition: The rate at which work is done or energy is used.

parameters.name: Loss of energy
parameters.definition: Energy that is wasted and does not help the useful job.

parameters.name: Loss of substance
parameters.definition: Material, parts or fluids that are lost or wasted, partly or fully, for a time or for good.

parameters.name: Loss of information
parameters.definition: Data or knowledge that is lost or becomes unavailable, partly or fully.

parameters.name: Loss of time
parameters.definition: Time that is wasted, or the total time an activity takes.

parameters.name: Quantity of substance
parameters.definition: The amount or number of materials, parts or elements in a system.

parameters.name: Reliability
parameters.definition: How well a system keeps doing its job as intended, without failing.

parameters.name: Measurement accuracy
parameters.definition: How close a measured value is to the true value.

parameters.name: Manufacturing precision
parameters.definition: How closely the real product matches its specification.

parameters.name: External harm affects the object
parameters.definition: How sensitive an object is to harmful effects from outside.

parameters.name: Object-generated harmful factors
parameters.definition: Harmful effects an object itself produces that lower efficiency or quality.

parameters.name: Ease of manufacture
parameters.definition: How easy and cheap it is to make the object.

parameters.name: Ease of operation
parameters.definition: How simple the object is to use: few steps, few people, little skill or training needed.

parameters.name: Ease of repair
parameters.definition: How easy it is to fix, service or maintain the object.

parameters.name: Adaptability or versatility
parameters.definition: How well an object copes with changing conditions or can be used in different ways.

parameters.name: Device complexity
parameters.definition: The number and variety of elements in a system and of the links between them.

parameters.name: Difficulty of detecting and measuring
parameters.definition: How hard, slow or costly it is to observe, check or measure the system.

parameters.name: Extent of automation
parameters.definition: How far the system does its job without human work or attention.

parameters.name: Productivity
parameters.definition: The amount of useful output per unit of time or per unit of cost.
